newsitem.title: USA: US corp junk bond deals keep market busy in August.
newsitem.headline: US corp junk bond deals keep market busy in August.

text.p: A hot new issue market for U.S. corporate high-yield bonds is keeping junk bond players busy in August and staving off the summer doldrums this year, according to market players.
"Things usually quiet down about now, but there are a slew of deals on the road," said one junk bond syndicate official. "This is turning into a very atypical August," he noted.
A slew of junk bond issues are scheduled to be priced this week and the forward calendar for August continues to grow, market sources noted.

Market players began talking yesterday about a $600 million debut junk bond offering from Fox/Liberty Media scheduled for mid-August. The deal, lead-managed by Merrill Lynch & Co, is notable not only for its size, but becuase it will be one of the few junk bond issues from a pure television programming company, they said.
Fox/Liberty Media is a joint venture between News Corp's Fox Sports unit and Liberty Media Corp, a unit of Tele-Communications Inc.
Proceeds will be used to purchase of a 40-percent interest in the regional sports networks of Rainbow Media Holdings.
Rainbow Media is an affiliate of Cablevision Systems Corp.
In other new issue news, preliminary price talk began circulating for Raytheon Corp's $2.5 billion high-grade corporate bond offering expected for Thursday.
Unofficial price talk on the five-year tranche was seen 40-45 basis points, 60-65 basis points for the 10-year tranche and 75-80 basis points on the 30-year tranche, market sources said.

Junk bond deals on deck for mid-week included a $200 million offering from ICN Pharmaceuticals Inc via Schroder Wertheim & Co, a two-part $320 million Euro/144a offering from MRS Logistica SA via BT Securities Corp and a $200 million 10-year deal from Signature Resorts Inc via Montgomery Securities.
